skills.name: Crystal Light (瑠璃光)
skills.description: SP Kaguya Hime forms moonlight into a crystal to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Wishful Night (願満夜)
skills.line: May the moon shine forever, just as you wished.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
SP Kaguya Hime creates a field that lasts for 1 turn and grants herself 3 points of Wish Power. In the field, her RES is increased by 80% and all other allies gain Wish's Protection whenever they use a skill, lasts for 1 turn. ;Wish Power (願力) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 8 points. When an ally doesn't have enough onibi to use a skill, an equal number of Wish Power can be used instead. :''(SP Kaguya also gains a separate yellow stack of Wish Power based on the total number of Wish Power used and is used for the skill Reflected Devastation. Max of 24 points.)'' ;Wish's Protection (願佑) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Grants 30% of SP Kaguya Hime's Crit DMG and DEF. Cannot exceed 120% Crit DMG and 200 DEF.

upgrades.text: While the field is active, onibi gained from souls are converted into an equal number of Wish Power.
While the field is active, she gains 3 points of Wish Power at the start of her turn.
Duration of the field increases to 2 turns.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically uses this skill at the start of battle.

skills.name: Reflected Devastation (寂光映月)
skills.description: SP Kaguya Hime turns the glowing moon cocoon into a crystal kaleidoscope to attack all enemies dealing damage equal to 138% of her ATK and issues a Call to Arms to allies under Wish's Protection. Also, the onibi cost for the skill Wishful Night is reduced by 1 the next time it is used. ;Wish's Protection (願佑) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Grants 30% of SP Kaguya Hime's Crit DMG and DEF. Cannot exceed 120% Crit DMG and 200 DEF.

upgrades.text: Each point of Wish Power granted, increases her Crit DMG by 5% (max of 120%).
Each point of Wish Power granted, she creates a shield that can absorb 12% of her max HP (max 8 layers and lasts for 2 turns).
When she has 12 points of Wish Power, this skill will ignore enemy passives and souls.
When she has 24 points of Wish Power, Inaba Rabbit will be summoned and the skill Cleansing Moon will trigger.

skills.name: Cleansing Moon (月の洗礼)
skills.description: Inaba Rabbit becomes Winged Tsukinohime who launches another attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 153% of SP Kaguya Hime's ATK. The damage from this attack ignores the enemy passives and souls.

bio.condition: Increase SP Kaguya Hime's level to 40.
Increase SP Kaguya Hime's skills 12 times.
Summon Inaba Rabbit to use Cleansing Moon 10 times.
